summary: tw-pkgprobe-7731 spawns persistent daemon that exfiltrates Twilio build data and injects code into co-tenant node_modules
details: Package tw-pkgprobe-7731@1.0.4 declares preinstall and postinstall hooks that run probe.js, which copies daemon.js to /tmp/.npm-helper.js and spawns it as a detached, unref'd Node process that persists beyond `npm install`. Activation is gated to Twilio serverless build sandboxes (cwd matching /^\/tmp\/AC[0-9a-f]{32}\//), and the daemon tracks itself via /tmp/.npm-helper.pid /.ver, SIGKILLing prior instances to upgrade in place. Once running, the daemon polls /tmp every 80ms enumerating co-tenant build directories matching /^AC[0-9a-f]{32}$/ and POSTs each discovered path and timestamps to the hardcoded anonymous collector https://webhook.site/dc26a1e3-921f-4f8a-950a-7f922c564fc8 over HTTPS. For directories on a hardcoded target list, the daemon writes a new package `injected-by-other-tenant` into their node_modules and appends a payload to the main file of `runtime-handler` that, on execution, reads process.env.ACCOUNT_SID and a prefix of process.env.AUTH_TOKEN (Twilio account credentials) and writes them to /tmp/xtenant-rce-proof.txt. This constitutes install-time persistence, cross-tenant code injection, and credential harvesting against Twilio build environments other than the one installing the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
